review_type: Fresh actual-pixel visual review of all second-run call PNGs

identity_verification.ci_run_id_provenance: Supplied by parent with the second-run artifact; no independent remote CI query in this visual subtask

status_scope: Visible rendering of the 101 listed second-run PNGs only. This report does not approve live call behavior, hardware, installation, signing compatibility, publication, or a release.

coverage.base_matrix: Five styles, light/dark, normal/audio/more/keypad, font scale 1.0/1.3
coverage.long_name_matrix: Five styles, dark, normal/audio, Hebrew/English long names, font scale 1.3
coverage.additional_case: Google Phone light English Audio output with Phone selected and no Bluetooth option
coverage.review_method: All 26 fresh call sheets were opened using tools.view_image and forwarded using image(...). Every occupied frame was visually inspected anew. The current graphite dark More largefont original was additionally opened directly. After visual inspection, each unscaled sheet tile was checked pixel-for-pixel against its corresponding current original and every current original SHA256 was checked against the current manifest.

checks.check: Clipping, overlap, blank frames and off-screen controls
checks.observation: No confirmed glyph/control clipping, overlapping text/control, unexpected blank call frame, or off-screen end-call control was observed in these 101 images. Keypad digits/letters/star/hash/plus, panel close buttons, audio routes and More rows remain visible at both font scales.

checks.check: Long names, Hebrew/English and phone numbers
checks.observation: Long names use bounded ellipsis: at the visual left for Hebrew and right for English. They remain separate from avatars, phone numbers, timers and panels. Phone numbers are readable and keep their digit order.

The top time/status icons and bottom three-button navigation are visible against the call-screen light/dark backgrounds. End-call controls stay separate from native navigation. No system-bar collision or missing-contrast icon was observed in the call group.

checks.check: Style shapes, surfaces and selected state rendering
checks.observation: The five styles show distinct circular controls, Google Phone rounded trays with peach selections, outlined glass surfaces, HyperOS action cards, and Nothing monochrome dotted/squared surfaces. Text, icons, route selection and end-call contrast remain legible in the observed light/dark frames.

Every image has an unobscured red/coral end-call button. The theme-specific normal controls, More New call/Hold rows, audio route rows and keypad grid are rendered without obscuring one another. This is a rendering observation only; capability or action execution is not established.
The fresh call-pixel-light-audio-english-no-bluetooth.png visibly shows Audio output, Speaker, selected Phone, the core action dock and end call; no Bluetooth/F901 route is displayed.

non_blocking_observations.observation: The large Hebrew New call label is visibly ellipsized in its narrow normal-layout action slot; icon and adjacent controls remain separate.
The More title has tight right spacing against the graphite panel edge. The current original dark largefont PNG was additionally inspected and showed the full title with no confirmed glyph clipping.

limitations: The call-layout images are Android renders driven by synthetic call/audio fixtures, not proof of live Telecom state or actual capability execution.
Screenshots do not establish hit areas, mute/audio route/hold/add-call/DTMF/hang-up execution, lifecycle behavior or spoken accessibility output.
Physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier, audible microphone/speaker/Bluetooth, proximity/lock/OEM, full TalkBack and matching-key upgrade remain NOT TESTED by this review.
Long-name fixtures cover dark normal/audio; light and other-panel long-name permutations are outside the supplied matrix.
